initial_query: Find a hotel building to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA) for 30 residents in Turin with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near healthcare services.
submitted_query: Find a hotel building to convert it into a residential senior care facility (RSA) for 30 residents in Turin with at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area in energy class D or better near healthcare services.
final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari'
  AND surface_area >= 1000
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E')
  AND healthcare >= 50
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User requires energy class D or better. Translated to all classes from D upward (A1-A4, B, C, D). Turin location, healthcare proximity, 1600 sqm gross floor area and the RSA/30-resident use are outside the energy scope and are not filtered here.

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area. The 30-resident capacity is not converted into an area threshold.

User explicitly asks for the building to be near healthcare services. For a residential senior care facility (RSA), proximity to healthcare is essential. Set at the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution, so the property sits in the top quartile for healthcare access.
